Run 2: 旅行很远：到很远的地方旅行，The verb phrase needs a destination expression; use a place after 到 rather than placing a distance directly after 旅行. [rule: word_choice]
Run 3: 旅行很远：去了很远的地方，Use a destination phrase with 去 to express travelling to a distant place; 旅行 cannot directly be modified by 很远 in this structure. [rule: none]
